source.name: NYSDEC, Oil, Gas & Other Regulated Wells (data.ny.gov)

at_risk.definition: NYSDEC status IN (inactive), SI (shut-in) or TA (temporarily abandoned), with an owner named.

notes: Status codes from the dataset's column description: AC active, IN inactive, SI shut-in, TA temporarily abandoned, PA plugged and abandoned, UN/UL/UM unknown (UL located and inspected, UM not found). Orphaned wells carry UN/UL/UM. Note the trailing space in the 'Well Status ' column name.

verification.method: Compared the owner joined from NYSDEC's full wells dataset with the owner on NYSDEC's separate Orphaned Wells dataset (data.ny.gov vgue-bamz), for every USGS New York well on that list.
